name.description: Name of the UI element. Possible values for users of any type: monitoring.dashboard, monitoring.problems, monitoring.hosts, monitoring.latest_data, monitoring.maps, services.services, services.sla_report, inventory.overview, inventory.hosts, reports.availability_report, reports.top_triggers. Possible values only for users of Admin and Super admin user types: monitoring.discovery, services.actions, services.sla, reports.scheduled_reports, reports.notifications, configuration.host_groups, configuration.templates, configuration.hosts, configuration.maintenance, configuration.actions, configuration.discovery. Possible values only for users of Super admin user type: reports.system_info, reports.audit, reports.action_log, configuration.event_correlation, administration.general, administration.proxies, administration.authentication, administration.user_groups, administration.user_roles, administration.users, administration.media_types, administration.scripts, administration.queue.

status.description: Whether access to the UI element is enabled. Possible values: 0 - Disabled; 1 - (default) Enabled.

tag.description: Tag name. If empty string is specified, the service tag will not be used for service matching.

value.description: Tag value. If no value or empty string is specified, only the tag name will be used for service matching.

status.description: Whether access to the module is enabled. Possible values: 0 - Disabled; 1 - (default) Enabled.

name.description: Name of the action. Possible values for users of any type: edit_dashboards, edit_maps, add_problem_comments, change_severity, acknowledge_problems, close_problems, execute_scripts, manage_api_tokens. Possible values only for users of Admin and Super admin user types: edit_maintenance, manage_scheduled_reports, manage_sla.

status.description: Whether access to perform the action is enabled. Possible values: 0 - Disabled; 1 - (default) Enabled.

rules.description: Role rules. Note: despite being documented with type 'array' on the method page, the API represents rules as a single object whose properties are the dotted keys below (per the object reference and worked examples).

ui.description: Array of the UI element objects.

ui.default_access.description: Whether access to new UI elements is enabled. Possible values: 0 - Disabled; 1 - (default) Enabled.

services.read.mode.description: Read-only access to services. Possible values: 0 - Read-only access to the services, specified by the services.read.list or matched by the services.read.tag properties. 1 - (default) Read-only access to all services.

services.read.list.description: Array of Service objects. The specified services, including child services, will be granted a read-only access to the user role. Read-only access will not override read-write access to the services. Only used if services.read.mode is set to 0.

services.read.tag.description: Service tag object. The tag matched services, including child services, will be granted a read-only access to the user role. Read-only access will not override read-write access to the services. Only used if services.read.mode is set to 0.

services.write.mode.description: Read-write access to services. Possible values: 0 - (default) Read-write access to the services, specified by the services.write.list or matched by the services.write.tag properties. 1 - Read-write access to all services.

services.write.list.description: Array of Service objects. The specified services, including child services, will be granted a read-write access to the user role. Read-write access will override read-only access to the services. Only used if services.write.mode is set to 0.

services.write.tag.description: Service tag object. The tag matched services, including child services, will be granted a read-write access to the user role. Read-write access will override read-only access to the services. Only used if services.write.mode is set to 0.

modules.default_access.description: Whether access to new modules is enabled. Possible values: 0 - Disabled; 1 - (default) Enabled.

api.access.description: Whether access to API is enabled. Possible values: 0 - Disabled; 1 - (default) Enabled.

api.mode.description: Mode for treating API methods listed in the api property. Possible values: 0 - (default) Deny list; 1 - Allow list.

actions.default_access.description: Whether access to new actions is enabled. Possible values: 0 - Disabled; 1 - (default) Enabled.

type.description: User type. Possible values: 1 - (default) User; 2 - Admin; 3 - Super admin.

rules.description: Role rules to be created for the role.
